reason: Repository evidence shows this plugin is a DeepSeek Harness extension that adds long-term, cross-session memory support by automatically capturing conversations and maintaining a four-layer memory pipeline (L0 raw logs, L1 atomic memory, L2 scene blocks, L3 persona), while offering tools for structured memory search and raw conversation retrieval; it is implemented as a DSH bundle plugin and relies on local storage plus optional remote embedding services for hybrid recall.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在对话中自动捕获并分层保存记忆，并在后续会话前自动回调相关记忆；同时提供 memory_search 与 conversation_search 工具用于结构化记忆和原始对话检索。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically captures and organizes conversations into layered memory, recalls relevant memory context for future turns, and exposes memory_search and conversation_search tools for structured memory and raw conversation lookup.

capabilities: Records conversation turns and stores memory artifacts under a local DSH memory directory
Builds and updates layered memory (raw logs, atomic memories, scene blocks, persona summaries)
Injects retrieved memories into prompt context during agent turns
Provides on-demand tools for structured memory search and raw conversation lookup
Supports optional vector/embedding retrieval via external OpenAI-compatible endpoints with fallback to keyword retrieval

reasons.code: Optional external embedding provider usage with API key configuration
Native data/processing dependency chain in packaged plugin
